answer: An agent network tracking sparrow populations across an arctic tundra with violet imaging mitigates Sybil attacks via proof-of-burn registration. Each identity must verifiably destroy a fixed balance of native tokens by sending them to an unspendable null address. An adversary incurs the scarce cost of unrecoverable liquid capital per simulated node. However, this mechanism favors well-capitalized attackers and disproportionately penalizes low-budget participants.
